name: kf/module-sdk
description: KF platform module SDK (PHP), derived from the Java reference SDK ro.kf:kf-module-sdk by /kf-sdk-derive: registers hooks, extension fields and UI contributions, answers the signed platform callbacks (POST /_kf/hooks) and verifies the signed context of the module's own routes. Zero runtime dependencies.

suggest.psr/http-factory: optional: the PSR-15 adapter Psr15/KfMiddleware (PSR-17 factories)
